moments.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride
God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him. And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom. So she is asking for them to be the greatest.

My daughter said to me the other day, Dad, I was only fifteen and you telling me I have got to be ready to die for the Lord, I was too young for you to be telling me that. And I said, I have to speak like that, because when things happen I do not want you to be confused. I know it scares you, but I do not want you confused if they come and lock me up and put me in prison or lie on me. That is why I tell you at a young age, eventually they are going to come for me, eventually I am going to die for this. I do not try to scare you, but I have to let you know what is going to happen, and the truth. It is a little scary, but I cannot water it down.

So real leaders understand that they will suffer. That is why Malcolm X said, I am dead already. Leaders understand that when a man is a revolutionary, that is how we think. Because a leader understands, if I keep teaching and waking my people up and changing my people, eventually the devil, the white man, he is coming for me. What do you think, they are going to leave me to be talking all this all the time? Right now they are watching. Eventually they are going to come for us. Every one of us is going to have to drink of that cup and go through that fire. We just have to pray that we can endure.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. You do not know what you are asking.

Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of? Remember when Christ was about to be crucified, he asked the Lord, take this cup from me. That cup goes into affliction. That cup goes into death. That cup goes into being hated. So what is this showing concerning being great? That you are going to suffer.

You do not know what you are asking for when you say, listen, I want to be a great leader, I want to be great in the kingdom, I want to be one of the 144. You had better understand what you are asking for. In order to obtain that seat you have to drink of the same cup Christ drank of. Every one of the 144 drank of that cup. Every last one of them suffered and was made perfect through the suffering, the same way Christ suffered and was made perfect. Every one of those brothers that follow the Lamb wherever he goes, they caught hell on this earth.

So you leaders rising up amongst us, your mind has got to be programmed that you are going to have to drink of that same cup that Christ drank of. There is no running from it. All the bishops, the deacons, we all know we have got to drink of that cup. I am going to suffer.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: And they say unto him, We are able. And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup. So the leaders will drink indeed of that cup. And one of them was beheaded, killed with the sword by Herod. And the other one was exiled on an island, on a salt mine. They tried to kill him but he could not die — they tried to boil him, burn him, and John was not dying, the Lord was protecting him. So they ended up exiling him, for his teachings, for the teachings of Christ.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister. Whoever is great among you, let him be your minister.

note.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant. And whoever is the chief man, this is Christ speaking, he is supposed to become a servant. This is the vocation in which you are called. A leader is called to be a servant to the people. Again, we are nothing if we cannot do our job, which is to instruct you. And if we are not instructing you wisely and properly, we are of no profit to God. We are servants to you, not you to us. We are to feed the flock, not the flock feed us.

note.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many. Wait a second. Christ did not come to be ministered unto. And to give his life as a ransom for many. That is the blueprint. You want to measure up to the full stature of Christ that you read in Ephesians, you have to become a minister to the people, and a ransom, and give your life for the people. Anything short of that, you are not fulfilling the duty that you said you were called into this truth for.

note.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: After you know your God and you know what nation you come from, God will give you purpose. The kingdom of heaven is like a householder who went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard: the vineyard is the nation of Israel, and he went looking for workers.

He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace: he saw people who had no purpose. That is us. You were going to the club, partying, caught up in Christianity. We were all idle; none of us had purpose.

And said unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right I will give you. The Lord called us, and he has a job, a purpose, for every last one of us. We were without purpose, but God called us and hired us.
Labourers hired at the third, sixth, ninth and eleventh hours all receive a penny, and those hired first murmur at it.
The wage here is the kingdom. A man labouring thirty years and a man who came in yesterday are working for the same thing, and each was called at the hour appointed for him.

note.label: Matthew 20: The Labourers in the Vineyard and the Cup He Drank

points: The householder answers that he does them no wrong; they agreed with him for a penny. Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own?

note.label: Matthew 20: The Labourers in the Vineyard and the Cup He Drank

points: He tells the twelve plainly what is coming: betrayed unto the chief priests and scribes, condemned to death, delivered to the Gentiles to mock and to scourge and to crucify, and the third day he shall rise again.

note.label: Matthew 20: The Labourers in the Vineyard and the Cup He Drank

points: The mother of Zebedee's children asks for her two sons to sit on his right hand and on his left.

note.label: Matthew 20: The Labourers in the Vineyard and the Cup He Drank

points: Ye know not what ye ask. They shall drink of his cup and be baptized with his baptism, but the seats are not his to give; they are for them for whom it is prepared of his Father.

note.label: Matthew 20: The Labourers in the Vineyard and the Cup He Drank

points: The princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, but it shall not be so among you. Whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister.

note.label: Matthew 20: The Labourers in the Vineyard and the Cup He Drank

points: The Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many. Men set over the congregation are servants to it, not lords over it.

note.label: Matthew 20: The Labourers in the Vineyard and the Cup He Drank

points: Two blind men cry after him, thou son of David, and will not be silenced by the multitude. He has compassion, touches their eyes, and they follow him.
